result.topic_en: Riemann defines the generalized derivative/integral ${}^x\partial^\nu_k z$ for nonnegative order via repeated differentiation and states its basic properties (composition, linearity, translation and scaling rules, corresponding values), with footnotes on an alternative series definition and an open question about uniqueness of the complementary functions $\varphi_\nu$.
